received_understanding: The report delivers a unified discriminative framework for 2025-2026 KV cache optimization: each of eight routes is characterized by which cache property it reduces (retained token count, per-element precision, subspace rank, query-dynamic selection, fixed recurrent memory, cache reuse, storage-tier migration) and by the mechanism differences, experimental evidence boundaries, and cross-route comparability of representative methods. The blind read confirms the manuscript's structure, its evidence-boundary statement (first-hand reading of 10 representative papers, search window Jan 2025 - Aug 2026, latest first-hand April 2026), and its cross-route judgments are internally coherent before attribution.
